When on, holding volume down for about 0.8 seconds opens the 3-Macaw Speech dictation sheet; after speaking, choose the app that gets the text. In the 3-Macaw Speech settings the key can be changed to holding volume up or pressing volume down twice. A short press still changes the volume. This service filters key presses only: it never reads the screen content and records nothing; the microphone is used only while the sheet listens. Keys are left alone while the screen is off or during a call.

Adds commas, periods and question marks to the text of recognition models that leave them out (Chinese and English). The English model also restores capital letters. SenseVoice adds its own punctuation and does not use these models.

Opens the dictation sheet when a Bluetooth headset calls the voice assistant (a long press on its voice key or touch area). If another app answers it too, the system asks you to choose. Allow \"Nearby devices\" when asked, so that the headset\'s microphone is heard and every press works
A loaded model is released after this time without use, for scripts as well

The key trigger is an accessibility service that only filters key presses. It never reads the screen content and records nothing; it opens the dictation sheet when you press the chosen key. A short press still changes the volume, and keys are left alone while the screen is off or during a call.\n\nTurn on 3-Macaw Speech key trigger in the system accessibility settings. If its switch is grayed out (apps installed from a package file on Android 13 and later), first open the app info of 3-Macaw Speech and choose Allow restricted settings in its menu.
Off. Tap to read how it works and open the system accessibility settings

The wake word is detected on the device; nothing is saved or sent. While listening the microphone stays open; when a script or another entry needs it, the wake word steps aside and resumes afterwards. A shorter listening time, or listening only while charging, saves battery.
Runs the wake word model only while it hears speech or another sound, not in a quiet room, which uses less battery. A very soft wake word may be missed
When the wake word opens the sheet, the recognized text is read aloud with a 3-Macaw Speech voice of its language, else with the system voice
Say a wake word to open the dictation sheet. While on, the microphone indicator stays lit, a notification stays and battery use rises
These settings apply to the tryout screen, the system voice input and the system text-to-speech engine. Scripts keep the documented defaults.
Used by the tryout screen. The system engine follows the rate of the system or of the app.
The Voice command tile was added
The Voice command tile is already in Quick Settings
1. Swipe down twice from the top of the screen to open Quick Settings.\n2. Tap the edit button (the pencil).\n3. Find the Voice command tile of 3-Macaw Speech and drag it into the panel.
Tap to add the Voice command tile. Then tap it in Quick Settings to speak, also on the lock screen
Each of these opens the same dictation sheet as the digital assistant. Nothing is recorded before the sheet listens, and the microphone is used only for the few seconds of dictation.

Tap Place on home screen, then confirm on the home screen. If no confirmation appears, add the widget by hand:

1. Long press an empty spot of the home screen and choose Widgets.\n2. Find Tap to speak of 3-Macaw Speech and drag it to the home screen.\nA long press on the app icon also shows the Voice command shortcut, which can be dragged to the home screen on its own.
